facts.fact: 治疗师开场指出“我们俩都没在认真听”，并把矛头指向“我”，练习只得重来。
facts.anchor: I don’t think that either of you are listening hard enough

facts.fact: 治疗师用墨迹卡（罗夏测试）让两人说出看到的形状，Leah 在每张卡上都只看见“眼睛”。
facts.anchor: is an eye, and an eye and an eye and an eye and an eye

facts.fact: 电话那头的官方口径把 Leah 的变化称为“resurfacing glitch（上浮故障）”，反复说很常见、不必担心，治疗费由 Centre 出。
facts.anchor: We call it the resurfacing glitch

facts.fact: 治疗前 Leah 已不肯穿衣、怕布料，回家后“我”发现她靴子里整片脚趾甲脱落，仍默默舀了一小量食盐进水里给她喝。
facts.anchor: spoon a small measure of table salt into a glass of water for Leah to drink

facts.fact: Sam 上门探视，从包里掏出一只用锡纸包着的整鸡，说是想帮点什么。
Sam 自陈谷歌了“减压病”，讲氮气泡在血液与组织里形成，会造成头晕、皮疹、疲倦、失忆甚至性格改变，并试探这是否可治。
facts.anchor: nitrogen bubbles form in the blood and the tissues and things when the pressure decreases

facts.fact: “我”独自在浴室擦浴缸，每擦一下海绵带下的垢是粉色的、比前几周更稠，怀疑与 Leah 的“变薄／变少”有关。
facts.anchor: the scrim that comes away with each stroke is pinkish

facts.fact: “我”回忆 Leah 教他“sea lung（海肺）”一词：古时水手用来称气温骤变时海面迅速冻结成的冰面浮层。
facts.anchor: an ancient term once used by sailors to describe the slough of ice

relations.kind: 伴侣；Leah 潜水归来后沉默、脱皮、畏衣，Miri 反复以“我的 Leah 不是现在这个”作对照
relations.anchor: my Leah is not who I have with me now

relations.kind: 夫妻治疗中的被指导者与被指认的“好战／爱归咎”一方
relations.anchor: too given to the process of blame

relations.kind: 邻居兼朋友；Sam 送食物、道歉式试探，Miri 半开门应付
relations.anchor: I just wanted to see if there was anything I could do

relations.kind: Leah 曾带“我”去核电站旁的海滩，那是她小时候与父亲散步的地方
relations.anchor: she’d used to go walking with her father

relations.kind: 治疗由 Centre 出资，条件是“后续协助会到位”，细节含糊
relations.anchor: bankrolled by the Centre on the understanding that further assistance will be forthcoming

numbers.value: 三周（合同）/ 六个月（实际滞留）
numbers.anchor: not staying away six months when your operation terms only stipulated three weeks

numbers.value: 六十年代中期（罗夏测试被广泛质疑的年代）
numbers.anchor: the Rorschach test not widely discredited around the mid-sixties
